#include <iostream>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

double absolute(double value) {
    return (value < 0) ? -value : value;
}

int main() {
    int x, y, n;
    cin >> x >> y >> n;
    int best_a = 0, best_b = 1;
    double min_diff = 1e15;
    double ratio = static_cast<double>(x) / y;

    for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
        int left = 0, right = 1000000000;
        while (right - left > 10) {
            int m1 = left + (right - left) / 3;
            int m2 = right - (right - left) / 3;
            double diff1 = absolute(ratio - static_cast<double>(m1) / j);
            double diff2 = absolute(ratio - static_cast<double>(m2) / j);
            if (diff1 > diff2)
                left = m1;
            else
                right = m2;
        }
        for (int i = left; i <= right + 3; ++i) {
            double current_diff = absolute(ratio - static_cast<double>(i) / j);
            if (current_diff < min_diff - 1e-15) {
                min_diff = current_diff;
                best_a = i;
                best_b = j;
            }
        }
    }
    cout << best_a << '/' << best_b;
    return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
